record.description: If the registration time is not observed (t_inst=⊥), finite Π cannot be directly measured; the paper uses a +∞ comparison convention. Empirical studies should treat censorship explicitly rather than inventing a registration instant.

math_callout.label: Right-Censored Institutional Registration Bound
math_callout.latex: t_{\text{inst}}(s) = \bot \text{ at horizon } T \implies \Pi_{\min}(s; T) = T - t_{\text{op}}(s)
math_callout.bridgeNote: Survival-analysis lower bound for right-censored institutional registration.
